'''Aurren Panteer''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who served as [[Lord/Legends|Lord]] of [[House Panteer]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|resurgent Sith Empire]]. He was the nephew of the Queen [[Silara Panteer]]. Around [[3643 BBY]], he dispatched an elite detachment of the [[Queensguard]] to accompany the Sith with the intention of arresting [[Bouris Ulgo]].
